text:
deploy-bot: staged-rollout started: service=inference, version=v3.2.1 -> target=5% canary across regions. rollout_id=r-2026-03-23-001. release-notes: https://git.redwood/release/v3.2.1

mira: @deploy-bot thanks — I'll keep an eye on p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache evictions. :eyes:

joel: seeing eu-west p99 climb from ~210ms -> ~242ms over last 3 minutes, no error spike yet.

sam: ops: can we pause increase until we understand kv-cache behavior? prefer hold at 5% for now.

alex: +1 hold. if it doesn't stabilize in 10m, pin eu-west back to v3.2.0.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. pausing further traffic increase for rollout_id=r-2026-03-23-001. percent remains 5%.

ops-bot: alert: kv-cache-evictions (eu-west) increased from 120/min -> 380/min. correlated with requests to /v1/generate.

mira: looks like an eviction storm after warm cache population. quick mitigation ideas: 1) increase cache size on eu nodes, 2) adjust prefetch/batch settings, 3) pin back.

joel: option 1 requires infra change, might take ~20m. option 2 is config change we can push in ~5m. i'd try config tweak first.

sam: i'm drafting rollback playbook in case config tweak doesn't help: https://confluence/redwood/rollback/r-2026-03-23-001 (creating now).

mira: config tweak: reduce max_concurrent_prefetch to 8 and bump kv_cache_threshold to 0.7 — testing on one canary host now. command: `deployctl config set inference --env eu-west --key max_concurrent_prefetch --value 8`

joel: test host looks better after tweak, p99 down to ~220ms. still above baseline though.

alex: decision call: hold at 5% for now, let the tweak run for 10m. if p99 doesn't approach baseline (-<10% from baseline) we pin eu-west to v3.2.0.

sam: acknowledged. if we need to pin, use: `deployctl pin --env eu-west --service inference --version v3.2.0 --reason "staged hold - kv-cache eviction"`

deploy-bot: pause confirmed. will not increase traffic. will notify if any automated rollback triggers fire.

ops-bot: note: automated rollback threshold remains 5xx-rate>0.5% OR p99>300ms for 3m. currently not met.

mira: updating release notes with a short known-issue entry for eu-west and the mitigation steps. will post a PR shortly.

joel: will re-evaluate in 10m and post a final go/no-go.

alex: +thumbsup: reconvene at 10m or sooner if alerts change.

sam: locking change-window: change-window remains 02:00-04:00 UTC; this is still inside window.

deploy-bot: thread closed to auto-escalation; manual messages still allowed.

(ended)
